tasks.label: Testbench: current file
args: set -e; input_file="$1"; tb_dir="$2"; source_dir="$2"; if [ "$(basename "$source_dir")" = tb ]; then source_dir="$(dirname "$source_dir")"; fi; build_dir="$source_dir/build/sim/$3"; set --; for source in "$source_dir"/*.sv "$source_dir"/*.v; do if [ -f "$source" ] && [ "$source" != "$input_file" ]; then set -- "$@" -l "$source"; fi; done; mkdir -p "$build_dir"; iverilog -g2012 -Y.sv -I "$tb_dir" -I "$source_dir" -y "$source_dir" -o "$build_dir/simulation.vvp" "$@" "$input_file"; cd "$build_dir"; vvp simulation.vvp; for waveform in *.vcd; do if [ -f "$waveform" ]; then exec gtkwave "$waveform"; fi; done; printf '%s\n' 'No VCD waveform found. Add $dumpfile and $dumpvars to the testbench.' >&2; exit 1
